marta: Planning to flip two runtime flags for v3.2 in prod tonight at 22:00 UTC — continuous_batching=true and kv_cache_opt=on. Rollout plan: 10% canary -> 50% -> 100% over ~30m. Anyone object?
ben: ack infra side. autoscale policy validated and capacity reserved for canary lane.
ada: perf runs on staging look fine: median +2ms, p95 unchanged. Load test passed at expected QPS.
lex: QA ran smoke set; sample prompts and end-to-end traces look clean. No top-level failures. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: CI status: all checks passed on release/3.2 (build 345) — unit, integration, load ✅
ops-runner: rollback path ready: revert feature flags via config-service, restart pools automated. Rollback job exists: rollback-20260317-rc3 (tested on staging).
marta: Quick smoke checklist (will run during canary):
```
- owner: @marta
- canary window: 15m @10%
- smoke queries: 5 (chat short, chat long, embeddings, rerank, stream)
- alerts: p95 latency > 400ms OR error-rate > 0.5% => rollback
- logs: tracing + token-level cost sampling enabled
- rollback steps: revert flags, restart runtime pool, monitor for 5m
```
ben: I'll be primary on-call 22:00-23:00. network and infra knobs ready.
ada: approved from perf side. no blockers.
lex: +1 QA. I'll watch traces and sample outputs during canary.
marta: thanks all — proceeding with canary at 22:00 UTC. ping here when canary starts and when we promote to 50%.
ops-runner: will post canary start/finish messages and keep rollback command handy.
ci-bot: deploy plan uploaded: https://ci.example.com/build/345/deploy-plan
marta: tagging owners: @ben @ada @lex @ops-runner — see you on the thread.
